newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - March 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prince Charles arrives in Riyadh on Wednesday to participate in a national culture and heritage festival.
- Private sector says ready to run Saudi Arabian Airlines' cargo, catering divisions.
- Saudi Arabia to spend 393 million to expand desalination plant in Mecca and other water projects.
- Islamic Development Bank takes part in setting up a Saudi investment firm in Kazakhstan with a capital of $20 million.
- Electricity spending in Medina is expected to reach five billion riyals within five years.
- United Arab Shipping Company signs cooperation agreements with German and Korean firms.
